name: Video Creator
tagline: Turns one topic into a finished explainer video, helpers doing the parallel work
description: Pick a topic and it runs the whole explainer pipeline for one video at a time: research, script, voice track, hand-drawn-style animation, edit, and a QA pass, ending with an unlisted YouTube upload for you to review. It spins up helper bots so several stages run side by side instead of in a queue.
author: Farzad
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
